name: Relevance
description: Measures how well the response aligns with the given context and the interesting fact provided. It assesses whether the continuation logically follows the preceding conversation and relates to the topic at hand.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 is not relevant at all and 5 is highly relevant.

name: Engagement
description: Evaluates the ability of the response to engage the conversation partner, encouraging further discussion or eliciting interest. It considers how likely the response is to prompt a meaningful exchange.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 is not engaging and 5 is highly engaging.

name: Coherence
description: Assesses the logical flow and clarity of the response. It checks whether the continuation is easy to understand and follows a logical sequence of ideas without abrupt shifts or confusion.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 is incoherent and 5 is highly coherent.

name: Creativity
description: Measures the originality and inventiveness of the response. It evaluates whether the continuation introduces novel ideas or perspectives that enrich the conversation.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 is not creative and 5 is highly creative.

name: Politeness
description: Evaluates the tone and manner of the response, ensuring it is respectful and considerate. It assesses whether the language used is appropriate and maintains a positive conversational atmosphere.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 is impolite and 5 is highly polite.

name: Fact Utilization
description: Assesses how effectively the interesting fact provided is incorporated into the response. It evaluates whether the fact is used in a meaningful way that enhances the conversation.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 is not utilized and 5 is effectively utilized.

name: Grammar and Syntax
description: Evaluates the grammatical correctness and sentence structure of the response. It checks for errors in grammar, punctuation, and syntax that might affect readability.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 is poor grammar and 5 is excellent grammar.
